extracted.intended_audience: readers and purchasers of children's and reference books (parents, young readers, book buyers)
extracted.subtask_description: A Project Gutenberg edition of a Victorian-era boys' adventure novel with publisher advertising copy and reference-book blurbs; useful for readers or analysts of turn-of-century children's/adventure literature and contemporaneous publishing standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: G. A. Henty books — wholesome and manly
rubrics_metrics.description: G. A. Henty has long held the field as the most popular boys' author. Always wholesome and manly, always heroic and of high ideals, his books are more than popular wherever the English language is spoken.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher emphasizes moral/ideological suitability for boys (wholesome, manly, heroic, high ideals) as a selling/evaluative criterion; physical production noted: "Each volume is printed on excellent paper from new large-type plates, bound in cloth, assorted colors, with an attractive ink and gold stamp. Price 75 Cents."

rubrics_metrics.name: Book physical production quality (binding, type, paper)
rubrics_metrics.description: Each volume is printed on excellent paper from new large-type plates, bound in cloth, assorted colors, with an attractive ink and gold stamp.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Physical production (paper quality, new large-type plates, cloth binding, attractive stamping) is presented as part of the book's quality; price points are provided (e.g., 75 cents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Captain Bonehill books — up-to-date and true to life
rubrics_metrics.description: Captain Bonehill's stories will always be popular with our boys, for the reason that they are thoroughly up-to-date and true to life. As a writer of outdoor tales he has no rival.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authenticity/modernity and realism in outdoor/adventure detail are highlighted as desirable qualities; publisher lists formats and pricing (illustrated, cloth, $1.25).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mrs. L. T. Meade's girls' books — purity and utility
rubrics_metrics.description: Mrs. L. T. Meade is essentially a writer for the home, with the loftiest aims and purest sentiments. Her books are girls' books—written for girls, and fitted for every home. Here will be found no maudlin nonsense... It is pure and wholesome literature of a high order with a lofty ideal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on moral tone, domestic suitability, and avoidance of sentimental excess as criteria for girls' literature; also notes consistent copyright, good printing, and cloth binding as production standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edward S. Ellis' books — national relevance
rubrics_metrics.description: Purely American in scene, plot, motives, and characters, the copyright works of Edward S. Ellis have been deservedly popular with the youth of America.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Books targeted to a national audience should reflect local scenes, plots, motives and characters; production attributes (large new type, good paper, handsome cloth binding) are again noted as quality markers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: modern and up to date
rubrics_metrics.description: It is modern and up to date, being based on the latest edition of the famous dictionary of the French Academy, and has been carefully revised with the latest and best English dictionaries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Currency and authoritative sourcing (based on Academy edition, revised with best English dictionaries) are presented as essential features for a practical bilingual dictionary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: plain, clear type suited for ready reference
rubrics_metrics.description: The type is plain, clear, and expressly suited for ready reference.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Legibility and typesetting optimized for quick lookup are criteria for usefulness in a reference work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: careful examples and idiomatic explanations
rubrics_metrics.description: Careful examples are given of the different senses of various words. Full explanation is made of all idiomatic phrases, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Providing illustrative examples and explaining idioms is a standard for clarity and practical usability in bilingual dictionaries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: special attention to verb intricacies
rubrics_metrics.description: Special attention has been devoted to the intricacies of verbs. Lists are given of Irregular and Defective Verbs, and of Nouns of Double Gender.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicit treatment of verb irregularities and gender-sensitive nouns is cited as an important feature for learners and practical users.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: compound verbs translated by equivalents
rubrics_metrics.description: Compound Verbs are translated by their corresponding equivalents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translating compound verbs to idiomatic equivalents (rather than literal word-by-word) is presented as a quality criterion for practical translation utility.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: obsolete words indicated
rubrics_metrics.description: Obsolete Words and Terms are specially indicated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Marking obsolete vocabulary helps users avoid out-of-date language and is a stated editorial feature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dictionary: supplementary reference material (proper names, measures)
rubrics_metrics.description: French and English Vocabularies are given of Proper Names, Historical, Mythological, and Geographical. Tables of French Coins, Weights, and Measures, with English equivalents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive supplementary resources (proper-name vocabularies and conversion tables) are included as part of the dictionary's practical value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pocket English-Spanish dictionary — audience-focused practicality
rubrics_metrics.description: An essentially practical English-Spanish and Spanish-English Pocket Dictionary, designed especially to meet the needs of the soldier, colonist, capitalist, traveler, or explorer in our new colonial possessions. Invaluable for visitors to Cuba, Porto Rico, the Philippine Islands, or Spain, and absolutely indispensable for American residents in those countries. Especially suited for commercial use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targeting a pocket dictionary to specific practical users (soldiers, travelers, merchants) and colonial/post-war needs is presented as an evaluative/design principle; binding and page-count/pricing information are provided to indicate format suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Format and pricing as marketing/quality signals
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple entries list format (12mo, crown 8vo), binding (Best English Cloth), page counts (e.g., 1122 pages, 475 pages), and prices (75 cents, $1.25).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publisher repeatedly uses format, binding, page-count and price as indicators of product quality and market positioning; these production/price attributes serve as implicit standards for buyers and retailers.
